keyFindings.description: Spec acceptance 2 fails: envoy-go at bc8cf8ad (run 40466398617, job 122094912911, merge ref a7850cfc = this head + main) prints 180006|0.8.7 and fails internal/dispatch/docs: TestCopiedAskQueriesAvoidSequentialScans/the_asks_of_an_issue's_copies and /the_asks_of_a_project's_copies, 'query plan sequentially scans asks; want asks_block_id_unique'. On 18 the planner runs owedCopiesQuery's asks check as a hashed SubPlan over a Seq Scan on asks (Disabled: true under enable_seqscan=off), so every settlement of a copy would scan asks once production is on 18. The subtests came in with main's b69f636f after this branch's forward merge, so the fix needs main's code on the branch. 77 other packages ok.

The row-sum check covers only the dispatch database's public tables, but the text says a mismatch means 'a dump that failed or stopped partway' and that 'once the checks match, the dump can go'. pg_dumpall dumps databases in name order, so a dump cut in any database after dispatch (dispatch_local, postgres, other work's databases) passes both checks. Add a printed check that the dump ends with pg_dumpall's '-- PostgreSQL database cluster dump complete' trailer, which it writes only on success, or say the checks cover the dispatch database alone.
